card.name: Decimal point in CTCAE version numbers
card.fires_on: The period after the version number (5 or 4) in "Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (NCI CTCAE) version 5.0", in adverse-reaction severity grading tables. Rarely on a digit inside a citation number.

modes.label: CTCAE version decimal
modes.description: The decimal point right after the version number of the CTCAE grading scale, just before the 0.
modes.example: Reactions Adverse Reaction Severity Graded according to National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (NCI CTCAE version 5<<.>>0) CABOMETYX Dosage

modes.label: Digit in a citation ID
modes.description: A digit inside a numeric article identifier in a reference list.

card.writes: It strongly suppresses the digit tokens, so the model expects a digit to follow this point only weakly, in line with the fixed "0" that comes next.
card.plain: It marks the dot in "version 5.0" of the adverse-event grading scale cited in dose-change tables.
